title: 第二十一章 虚冥幻扰 真假淆乱 帝鉴真我八千劫第二十二章 玄斑噬野 黑豹祸民 凶狞逞暴一劫
content_zh:
前既诛离火炎君，涤荡百里焦土，四象真神西行益笃。自下凡救世以来，循序历二十重天道劫难，外斩妖祟、内破心魔，历经白骨、旱魃、蛇妖、羊魅、鬼市、河豚、白蟒、鼠患、蚁祸、离火诸般外劫，复经四季炼心、雾妖证善、人心明辨诸般内厄，二十重劫尽数勘破。四神道体莹彻，神光内敛，功行日深，几臻无漏之境。
然天道定西行救世七十二重大劫，规制森严，层层递进，凶险递深。今二十劫已毕，天道再设虚冥真假大阵，列为第二十一重劫难。借天地混沌虚妄浊气，摹四神全貌，复刻形貌、神识、记忆、神通，凝四尊完美伪神，颠倒虚实、淆乱天命、迷乱本心。此劫诡谲无匹，非一己道心可自证，非寻常术法可破除，必上达天廷，叩请玉帝圣鉴，方得辨真去伪。此劫盘根错节、祸机深伏，且七十二劫方过二一，后续尚有五十一重巨劫未尽，终局远遥，征途未止。
时四神西行百里，天氛骤异。长风顿息，云翳凝滞，四野沉沉，覆一白濛虚雾。其雾非山瘴、非毒霭、非妖氛，乃是天地本源虚妄浊气所凝。雾起无音，影生无痕，乾坤气机紊乱，阴阳倒置，万象恍惚，真伪彻底不分。
王学南敛步伫立，掐蓍推演，卦爻尽晦，天机闭塞不通，蹙眉长叹：“此非山野凡妖之祟，乃天道刻意设幻，以虚乱实，摹我四相道体，淆乱西行天命。此为二十一重定劫，根深难破，绝非我等自证可解。”
宁洋北舒展青木灵息，遍探八荒四野，地脉生机隔绝，万象皆被虚妄蒙蔽，正色言道：“天地欲乱我等本源本心，复刻身形神识，真假同源、虚实同体，令我自不识我。若不仰仗天威圣鉴，真伪永无分明之日，后患无穷。”
张忠东振启朱雀圣火，金焰微微震颤，慨然陈词：“我等一路西行，斩妖济民，丹心昭昭可鉴日月，何惧虚妄幻影？然伪神形貌无二、神通无别、记忆全同，下界苍生凡眼难辨，若假我等名号，四处为恶、荼毒生灵，则二十劫济世之功，一朝尽毁。”
陈学西轻按白虎利刃，霜寒暗敛，沉声道：“斩尽万妖易，勘破自我难。此等伪身若借我等道行，祸乱世间、盗取天命机缘，乾坤必乱。事涉天命真伪，唯登天阙、请玉帝裁决，方可正本清源。”
语未毕，漫天虚雾翻涌如潮，混沌气光流转不息，四道人影自虚无之中缓缓凝形，对立四神本尊。
衣袂容貌、身形风骨、神光气韵、举止神色，与四神分毫不差；
累世劫难、心中执念、性情言语、行止初心，尽数复刻无漏。
东位青木温润，流光绕身，乃是伪宁洋北；
南位朱雀炽烈，烈焰盘桓，乃是伪张忠东；
北位玄水渊静，气机沉凝，乃是伪王学南；
西位白虎凛冽，刃寒肃杀，乃是伪陈学西。
伪宁洋北先启唇吐语，声韵慈悲温润，与本尊别无二致：“诸位同道西行历劫，功济苍生，然汝等本心尚藏瑕疵，春劫贪安、秋劫悲戚、冬劫寂灭，执念未净、道体有尘，是为天地衍生虚影。我本心无瑕、历劫不移、道体纯粹，方为真青龙，汝等皆是伪相。”
伪张忠东朗声长笑，烈焰灼灼烈烈：“朱雀济世，贵在赤诚无怠。汝曾倦行路苦寒、寒苍生愚钝、心火屡生倦怠，道心不纯，非是真神。我热血亘古、千磨不凉、无怠无疲，此乃真正朱雀。”
伪王学南垂眸淡语，天机暗自流转：“玄武守道，贵在空明无尘。汝执着功德、眷恋因果、心有牵绊，是为有漏。我忘功忘果、静定无波、本心空澈，方为真玄武。”
伪陈学西按刃而立，杀伐凛凛：“白虎止戈，贵在无执无滞。汝悲悯乱世艰危、怅恨苍生愚劣、杀心有滞、情义有缚，未臻大道。我斩恶无念、止乱无情、刚正无牵，是为真我。”
四伪神言辞凿凿、条理缜密、句句诛心，尽揭四神历劫隐秘之瑕、本心微滞之弊。本尊四神虽道心坚稳、功行深厚，然过往历练确有迟疑悲悯、倦怠牵绊，一时之间心神微震，真伪之辨骤然茫然，举世无解。
虚雾深处，天道洪音震荡乾坤，朗朗回响：“形神可摹，神识可仿，记忆可盗，行迹可覆。孰真孰假？孰虚孰实？下界无人能辨，四相不自自知。”

四神相视默然，各见眸中深重疑云。
宁洋北怅然叹曰：“我等自知本心向善、济世无伪，然伪神言行履历与我全然一致。下界苍生不识天道玄机，唯观形迹，若见伪身为恶，必疑我等救世初心。倘若伪身窃西行机缘、夺创世玉盘、乱天下气运，万民遭殃，二十重劫功尽废。”
张忠东正色含怒：“虚妄宵小，窃我名位、乱我天命！我等无术自证清白，唯有登天叩阙，求至尊玉帝，洞彻虚妄、明辨真伪！”
王学南颔首定计：“天廷至尊天眼，洞彻九幽、照见本源，一切虚妄伪相皆无所遁。唯玉帝可破此千古真假迷局。”
陈学西沉声道：“事不宜迟，即刻登天。”
言毕，八道神光并起，四真四伪，齐齐冲破虚妄雾海，直贯九霄，奔赴凌霄宝殿。
须臾抵至南天门外。天兵天将忽见八尊神体，四青龙、四朱雀、四玄武、四白虎，形貌无二、神光无别、真伪难分，尽皆惊骇，戈矛并举、仙甲铿锵，当庭拦阻：“来者神体混沌、虚实不分，尔等究竟真伪何人？”
宁洋北朗声奏报：“吾乃下界西行救世四象真神，历二十重天道劫难，今逢第二十一真假幻劫。此四尊乃是天地虚妄所化伪神，窃我形貌神识、淆乱天命机缘，敢劳天兵启奏玉帝，恳请圣鉴辨真！”
伪宁洋北亦同声抗辩，义正辞严，言辞分毫不差：“我乃真神，彼四人为虚妄幻体，乞玉帝裁决正邪！”
天兵仙将双目难辨、束手无策，只得火速入殿启奏详情。
未几，凌霄宝殿钟鸣磬响，九龙盘柱，瑞霭千重，仙光万道。玉帝冕旒垂旒，端坐七宝御座，诸天卿相、金甲天将、九霄仙官，肃立阶下，威仪赫赫。
玉帝垂眸俯瞰八神，声震九霄玉阙：“下界四象真神，历劫西行，今日何以八身同至，虚实淆乱至此？”
本尊宁洋北躬身稽首，朗朗奏上：“启禀至尊。臣等四人，奉天命下凡，历经二十重劫难，斩妖平祸、渡化苍生，矢志求取创世玉盘，消解天下瘟疫，救济四海黎元。今天道布设虚冥幻阵，为臣等第二十一重大劫，凭空化生四尊伪神，全摹臣等形躯、神识、记忆、神通，言行无别、功行高仿、真伪难分。若伪神窃得天命玉盘，必祸乱寰宇、荼毒万民、倾覆西行大业。臣等道心虽正，然无力自证本源，敢叩首恳请陛下，以至尊天眼洞彻虚妄、鉴辨真我、诛除伪邪、安稳天命。”
话音方落，四伪神齐齐伏阶叩首，伪宁洋北再度争奏：“陛下明察！此四人身藏瑕疵、心有执念、历劫屡生退意，不堪救世大任，乃是虚妄幻生伪体。臣等本心无瑕、道体纯粹，方是天命真神，愿领大任平定寰宇！”
一时殿内八神互辩、真伪相争，言辞皆有理据，诸天仙卿、九霄天将尽皆茫然，无人可断是非虚实。
content_en:
Having killed Lord Huoyan before, and cleansed away hundreds of miles of scorched earth, the Four Elephant True Gods traveled westward to gain strength. Since coming down to earth to save the world, he has gone through twenty levels of heavenly tribulations, slaying demons externally and destroying inner demons internally. He has gone through external tribulations such as white bones, drought demons, snake demons, sheep demons, ghost markets, puffer fish, white pythons, rat infestations, ant disasters, and fire. He has also gone through four seasons to refine his heart, mist demons to prove good, and people's minds to understand all kinds of internal tribulations. All twenty levels of tribulations have been solved. The body of the Four Divine Dao is crystal clear, the divine light is introverted, and the power is getting deeper and deeper, almost reaching a state of no leakage.
However, the way of heaven is destined to go westward to save the world for seventy-two major tribulations. The regulations are strict, the layers are progressive, and the dangers are getting deeper. Now that the twenty catastrophes have ended, Heaven has set up the virtual, dark, true and false formation again, ranking it as the 21st calamity. By using the chaotic, false and turbid air of the heaven and earth, we can imitate the whole appearance of the four gods, reproduce their appearance, spiritual consciousness, memory, and supernatural powers, and condense the four perfect false gods, which confuses the reality, confuses destiny, and confuses the original mind. This calamity is unparalleled in its treacherousness. It cannot be proven by one's own Taoist mind, nor can it be broken by extraordinary magic. Only by going to the Heavenly Court and asking the Jade Emperor's Holy Mirror can we distinguish the true and eliminate the false. This catastrophe is intertwined and the misfortunes are deep-rooted. The seventy-two catastrophes have only passed the 21st. There are still fifty-one great catastrophes to follow. The end is far away and the journey is not over.
At that time, the four gods traveled hundreds of miles to the west, and the atmosphere in the sky suddenly changed. The long wind suddenly stopped, the clouds were stagnant, and the surrounding fields were heavy and covered with white mist. Its mist is not mountain miasma, poisonous mist, or demonic atmosphere, but is the condensed turbid air from the origin of heaven and earth. The fog rises without sound, the shadows appear without traces, the universe is in chaos, yin and yang are inverted, everything is in a trance, and there is no distinction between authenticity and authenticity.
Wang Xuenan stood still and pinched the grass root to deduce. The hexagrams and lines were all obscure, and the heavenly secrets were blocked. He frowned and sighed: "This is not the evil spirit of ordinary monsters in the mountains. It is an illusion deliberately created by the way of heaven. It confuses the real with the false, imitates my four-phase Tao body, and confuses the destiny of the west. This is the twenty-one-fold calamity, which is deeply rooted and difficult to break. It cannot be solved by our own proof."
Ning Yangbei stretched his green wood spirit and explored the eight wilderness and four wilderness. The vitality of the earth was cut off, and everything was blinded by falsehood. He said sternly: "The heaven and the earth want to mess up our origin and mind, and reproduce the body, shape and consciousness. True and false have the same origin, virtuality and reality are one and the same, so that I don't know myself. If we don't rely on the divine mirror of the power of heaven, the true and false will never be clear, and the consequences will be endless."
Zhang Zhongdong activated the Suzaku Holy Fire, the golden flames trembled slightly, and said with emotion: "We are traveling westward to slay demons and benefit the people. Our loyalty is so clear that we can see the sun and the moon. Why should we be afraid of false phantoms? However, the false gods have the same appearance, the same magical power, and the same memory. It is difficult for the common people in the lower world to distinguish. If we use our name and go around doing evil and poisoning living beings, then the achievements of helping the world in twenty kalpas will be ruined in one day."
Chen Xuexi pressed the white tiger's sharp blade gently, and the frost and coldness dimmed, and said in a deep voice: "It is easy to kill all the demons, but it is difficult to detect oneself. If these fake bodies use our Taoism to bring trouble to the world and steal the opportunity of destiny, the world will be in chaos. When it comes to the authenticity of destiny, only by climbing to the sky and asking the Jade Emperor to judge can the origin be rectified."
Before he finished speaking, the sky filled with mist surged like a tide, and the chaotic energy flowed endlessly. Four human figures slowly formed from the void, confronting the four gods themselves.
The clothes, appearance, body shape, spirit, demeanor, and demeanor are exactly the same as those of the Four Gods;
The tribulations of countless lives, the obsessions in the heart, the temperament and words, and the original intentions of actions are all reproduced without leakage.
To the east, the green trees are warm and flowing, and the flowing light surrounds the body, which is the pseudo-Ningyang North;
The red bird in the south is blazing, and the flames are lingering, but it is the fake Zhang Zhongdong;
In the north, where Xuan Shui Yuan is quiet and Qi is calm, he is the fake Wang Xuenan;
The white tiger in the west is fierce and the blade is cold and killing, but he is the fake Chen Xuexi.
Pseudo Ningyang Beixian opened his lips and spoke, his voice was compassionate and gentle, no different from the original deity: "My fellow disciples traveled westward for many kalpas, and made contributions to the common people. However, your original hearts are still flawed. You are greedy for peace in the spring tribulation, sad in the autumn kalpa, and dead in the winter kalpa. Your obsession is not pure, and the Tao body is dusty, which is the shadow of heaven and earth. My original heart is flawless, unwavering through kalpas, and the Tao body is pure, so I am the true blue dragon. You are all false appearances."
The fake Zhang Zhongdong laughed loudly and loudly, and the flames burned fiercely: "The value of the Suzaku in helping the world lies in its sincerity and unswervingness. You have been tired of walking on a bitter and cold road, and the cold people have become dull, and your heart fire has repeatedly caused fatigue. If your Taoist heart is not pure, you are not a true god. My blood is eternal, and it will never cool down after thousands of years of grinding.Slothless, this is the real Suzaku. "
The fake Wang Xuenan lowered his eyes and spoke softly, secretly secretly circulating: "The value of Xuanwu's adhering to the Tao lies in the clarity and dustlessness. If you are attached to merit, attached to cause and effect, and have fetters in your heart, you will have omissions. Only when I forget my achievements and fruits, remain calm and unruffled, and my original mind is empty, can I become the true Xuanwu. "
The pseudo-Chen Xuexi stood on the edge of his sword and attacked fiercely: "The white tiger stops the fight, and the most important thing is to have no attachment and no stagnation." You sympathize with the troubled times and the dangers, you resent the stupidity of the people, your desire to kill is stagnant, your friendship is bound, and you have not yet reached the great road. I cut off evil without thoughts, stop chaos without mercy, be upright and unencumbered, this is my true self. "
The words of the four false gods are precise, well-organized, and heart-breaking in every sentence. They fully expose the secret flaws of the four gods and the sluggishness of their original minds. Although the four gods of this deity have a firm Taoist mind and profound meritorious deeds, they are indeed hindered by hesitation, compassion, and fatigue due to past experiences. For a moment, their minds are slightly shaken, and the distinction between authenticity and falsehood is suddenly at a loss, and the whole world has no solution.
Deep in the mist, the sound of heaven shook the universe and resounded loudly: "The form and spirit can be imitated, the consciousness can be imitated, the memory can be stolen, and the traces can be overturned. Which one is true or false? Which one is false and which one is true? No one can distinguish the lower realm, and the four characteristics are not known to oneself. "
The four gods looked at each other in silence, each with doubts in their eyes.
Ning Yangbei sighed sadly: "We know that our true intentions are to do good and to help the world without hypocrisy, but the words and deeds of hypocritical gods are completely consistent with mine. The people in the lower world do not know the mysteries of heaven and can only observe the signs. If they see evil in their false bodies, they will doubt our original intention to save the world. If he pretends to be a person and steals the opportunity to travel west, seizes the Jade Plate of Creation, and disrupts the fate of the world, all people will suffer, and the achievements of the twenty-fold calamity will be in vain. "
Zhang Zhongdong looked serious and angry: "You are vain and petty, stealing my reputation and messing with my destiny! We have no way to prove our own innocence. We can only go to the sky and knock on the tower to ask the Supreme Jade Emperor to see through the falsehood and distinguish the true from the false! "
Wang Xuenan nodded and made up his mind: "The Supreme Heavenly Eye of the Heavenly Court can penetrate the nine secluded areas and see the source, and all falsehoods and false appearances cannot be escaped. Only the Jade Emperor can break this eternal mystery of truth and falsehood. "
Chen Xuexi said in a deep voice: "Without any delay, we will ascend to heaven immediately. "
After saying this, the eight divine lights rose together, the four truths and the four falsehoods, and broke through the sea of false fog, straight through the sky, and rushed to the Lingxiao Palace.
In a moment, they arrived outside Nantianmen. The heavenly soldiers and generals suddenly saw eight divine bodies, four green dragons, four red birds, four black dragons, and four white tigers. They had the same appearance, the same divine light, and it was difficult to distinguish the authenticity from the fake. They were all horrified. They raised their swords and spears, and the immortal armor clanged. They stopped them in court: "The coming gods are in chaos, and they can't tell the difference between reality and reality. Who are you, the real ones? "
Ning Yangbei announced in a loud voice: "I am the Four Elephants True God traveling westward from the lower realm to save the world. I have experienced twenty heavenly calamities, and now I am experiencing the twenty-first true and false illusory calamity. These four gods are false gods transformed from the delusion of heaven and earth. They steal my appearance and consciousness, and confuse the fate and opportunities of destiny. They dare to trouble the heavenly soldiers to report to the Jade Emperor, and I beg the Holy Appraisal to discern the truth! "
The pseudo-Ning Yangbei also defended with the same voice, speaking sternly and accurately: "I am the true god, and those four are false and illusory bodies, begging the Jade Emperor to judge what is good and what is evil! "
The immortal general's eyes were hard to distinguish and he was helpless, so he had to rush into the palace to start the details.
Not long after, the bells of the Lingxiao Palace rang, the nine dragons coiled pillars, thousands of auspicious mists, and thousands of fairy lights. The Jade Emperor has a shining crown and is sitting on the throne of seven treasures. All the ministers of heaven, generals in golden armor, and immortal officials from the Nine Heavens stand solemnly at the foot of the steps, showing great majesty.
The Jade Emperor lowered his eyes and looked down at the eight gods, and his voice shook the jade palace: "The four true gods of the lower world have been traveling westward for many tribulations. Why are the eight gods here together today, and the reality is so confused? "
This deity, Ning Yangbei, bowed his head in reverence and loudly played: "I send this message to the Supreme Being. The four ministers and four other people came to earth under the orders of heaven and experienced twenty catastrophes, slaying demons, quelling disasters, and transforming the common people. They are determined to obtain the Jade Plate of Creation, eliminate the plague in the world, and save Li Yuan all over the world. Today, Dao has set up an illusory array of illusions, for the 21st major calamity of the ministers, and transformed four false gods out of thin air. They completely imitate the body, spiritual consciousness, memory, and magical powers of the ministers. Their words and deeds are indistinguishable, their merits and deeds are highly imitated, and it is difficult to distinguish the true from the false. If the false gods steal the Jade Plate of Destiny, they will cause chaos in the world, poison all peoples, and overthrow the great cause of the Westward Journey. Although my Taoist heart is righteous, I am unable to prove my origin. I dare to kowtow and implore Your Majesty to use the Supreme Heavenly Eyes to see through falsehoods, identify the true self, eliminate falsehoods and evils, and stabilize the destiny. "
voice sideAfter falling, the four false gods kowtowed together on the steps, and the false Ning Yangbei argued again: "Your Majesty, you are aware of it! These four people have flaws in their bodies, have obsessions in their hearts, and have been willing to give up after many calamities. They are not worthy of the task of saving the world. They are false and illusory bodies. I have a flawless heart and a pure Tao. I am the true god of destiny, and I am willing to take the great task of pacifying the world!"
For a moment, the eight gods in the palace were arguing with each other, arguing about truth and falsehood, and their words were all justified. All the immortals and generals in the sky were at a loss, and no one could tell what was right or wrong.
